limitations: Source/import review only; no rendered parity, standalone gameplay, human readability, pacing or performance qualification.

Only exact path and both complete hashes authorize review reuse after any source/native change.
Rune retains its reviewed default/pass serialization difference; visual/temporal parity is not claimed.
Earlier camera-release-input-review.json and other candidate reports remain unchanged historical records.
